hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(internal/api/|frontend/src/gen/|internal/database/models/)'; then echo "Do not edit generated files. Edit the proto source or SQL and run make buf / make sqlc-gen." >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\bgo build\b' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'make'; then if [ -z "$(ls -A /workspaces/openmanetd/static 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'Warning: static/ is empty. Use make build instead of go build directly, or run make frontend first.' >&2; fi; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/proto/'; then echo 'Auto-running make buf...' >&2; make -C /workspaces/openmanetd buf >&2; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '(schema|query)\.sql$'; then echo 'Auto-running make sqlc-gen...' >&2; make -C /workspaces/openmanetd sqlc-gen >&2; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE 'frontend/src/.*\.(js|jsx)$' && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'src/gen/'; then pnpm -C /workspaces/openmanetd/frontend run lint:fix -- "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
